dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us6000pmsr](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us6000pmsr) Magnitude 5.5 earthquake at 98.539 depth occurred on Jan 28 2025 80km SE of Tolitoli. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude 0.4432 longitude 121.2107. It impacted 70178 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
